shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"parquet_schoolsupdate_source",

    Table.ReorderColumns(
        Source,
        List.Sort(Table.ColumnNames(Source))

    #"Replaced value" =

    #"Added custom" =

    #"Replaced value 5" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added custom", "Not 301220000", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),  
  
    #"Sorted rows" =  
        Table.Sort(#"Replaced value 5", {{"school_status", Order.Descending}}),

  #"Replaced value 3" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 7", null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),  
  
    #"Replaced value 11" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 3", "", "None", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),  
  
    #"Added custom 1" =  
        Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced value 11", "Importschooldone", each false, type logical),

        Table.AddColumn(#"Added custom 1", "countryid", each 710),  
  
    #"Added custom 3" =

  #"Removed other columns" = Table.SelectColumns(#"Replaced value 8", {"address", "agreement_type", "break_even_fee", "capacity", "city_id", "contract_start_date", "countryid", "ecd_code", "id", "Importschool", "Importschooldone", "monthly_salaries", "name", "number_of_classrooms", "owner_id", "region_id", "school_commencement_date", "school_id", "school_status", "segment"}),

  #"Duplicated column" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Renamed columns", "tcbgrow_AppAccountCreationDate", "tcbgrow_ContractDate"),
  #"Renamed columns 1" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Duplicated column", {{"countryid", "tcbgrow_Country.tcbgrow_AppID"}}),
